Thick fries cooked twice, at 140C then 190C until crisp, salted and served in paper cones with tomato sauce.
Snapper cubes cured in lime juice with red onion, chilli and coriander, served in small cups with sweet potato and corn.

s.note: the diner where Mutt finds Indy
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick fries. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes, rest, then at 190C until crisp. Salt with flaky salt and serve in paper cones with tomato sauce.

Dice 400g very fresh snapper and cover with the juice of 6 limes for 15 minutes. Add thin red onion, a chopped chilli and coriander. Serve in small cups with cubes of boiled sweet potato and corn kernels.

m.how: Marinate 1.2kg chicken drumsticks in 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and lime juice. Roast at 220C for 40 minutes until charred. Blitz coriander, a jalapeño, 100g mayo and lime for sauce. Serve with 1kg fries.

w.how: Soak 6 gelatine sheets. Heat 500ml water with 150g sugar and the juice of 3 lemons and stir in the gelatine. Layer halved green grapes and blueberries in glasses, pour over the jelly and set 4 hours.

d.note: the diner where Mutt and Indy talk
d.how: For each shake, blend 3 scoops vanilla ice cream with 150ml cold milk and 1 tbsp malted milk powder until thick. Pour into tall glasses. Makes four.
